description_en: Restores specific databases or tables of an ApsaraDB RDS instance to the original instance
description_zh: 该接口拥有恢复RDS实例的某些数据库或表到原实例
name: RestoreTable

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The backup set ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26273.html operation to query the list of backup sets.

You must specify at least one of BackupId and RestoreTime
parameters.help_zh:
备份集ID。您可以通过DescribeBackups接口获取备份集列表。

BackupId和RestoreTime两者至少传入一个
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en: Any point in time within the backup retention period. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 备份保留周期内的任意时间点。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 BackupId和RestoreTime两者至少传入一个。 实例必须已开启https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98818.html
parameters.name: restore_time

parameters.help_en:
The databases and tables to restore.
RDS PostgreSQL supports restoring only specified databases, not specified tables.

Format for RDS MySQL: ```[{"type":"db","name":"<Database 1 name>","newname":"<New database 1 name>","tables":[{"type":"table","name":"<Table 1 name in database 1>","newname":"<New table 1 name>"},{"type":"table","name":"<Table 2 name in database 1>","newname":"<New table 2 name>"}]},{"type":"db","name":"<Database 2 name>","newname":"<New database 2 name>","tables":[{"type":"table","name":"<Table 3 name in database 2>","newname":"<New table 3 name>"},{"type":"table","name":"<Table 4 name in database 2>","newname":"<New table 4 name>"}]}]```

Format for RDS PostgreSQL: ```[{"type":"db","name":"<Database 1 name>","newname":"<New database 1 name>"}]```
parameters.help_zh:
指定恢复的库表。
RDS PostgreSQL仅支持恢复指定数据库，不支持恢复指定表。

RDS MySQL格式：```[{"type":"db","name":"<数据库1名称>","newname":"<新数据库1名称>","tables":[{"type":"table","name":"<数据库1内的表1名称>","newname":"<新的表1名称>"},{"type":"table","name":"<数据库1内的表2名称>","newname":"<新的表2名称>"}]},{"type":"db","name":"<数据库2名称>","newname":"<新数据库2名称>","tables":[{"type":"table","name":"<数据库2内的表3名称>","newname":"<新的表3名称>"},{"type":"table","name":"<数据库2内的表4名称>","newname":"<新的表4名称>"}]}]```

RDS PostgreSQL格式：```[{"type":"db","name":"<数据库1名称>","newname":"<新数据库1名称>"}]```
parameters.name: table_meta

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable fast restoration for individual databases and tables. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled.

For more information about fast restoration for individual databases and tables, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/103175.html
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启极速库表恢复。取值：
true：开启
false：关闭

关于极速库表恢复的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/103175.html
parameters.name: instant_recovery
